clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Samophlange is hidden inside an automated control console. Goblin mechanics cannot explain what the strange component does.

Samophlange lies inside a control console in the Barrens, behind a maze of wiring and hollow tubes. It takes careful searching to free the component from its housing. It looks like a vital part of clockwork and steam machinery, but goblin tinkerers cannot make sense of its purpose. They mean to send it to the Tinkers' Union in Undermine, though the fragile piece may not survive rough handling.
